finding.title: Recon:EC2/PortProbeUnprotectedPort
finding.description: A sandbox honeypot intentionally exposed for red-team training triggered a low-noise GuardDuty port probe event that is expected in this environment.

llm_analysis.summary: The finding indicates a port probe on an EC2 instance that is a sandbox honeypot intentionally exposed for red-team training. The event is low severity and expected in this environment.
llm_analysis.rationale: The instance is tagged as a sandbox environment and is intentionally exposed as a honeypot for training purposes. The port probe is a low-noise event and is expected behavior in this controlled scenario, reducing the risk of actual compromise.
indicators: Expected event in red-team training environment
llm_analysis.recommended_action: No immediate remediation required. Continue monitoring the sandbox environment for any unexpected or higher severity findings. Ensure that production environments are not similarly exposed.

policy_decision.recommended_action: El recurso i-0sandboxhoneypot999 no esta en el inventario, asi que no se puede valorar su explotabilidad: se desconoce su entorno, su criticidad y si esta expuesto a internet. Revisar manualmente e inventariar el recurso.

fuente: Samples sinteticos de GuardDuty e Inspector en mvp/data/samples/
advertencia: Datos sinteticos de demostracion. Los findings estan anonimizados y el inventario, el historial y el catalogo KEV/EPSS son locales.
